'''Jizal Taphan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who targeted [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] ships passing through the [[Duro system/Legends|Duro system]], specifically shipments carrying [[Spice/Legends|spice]] and other illegal cargo.<ref name="University" />
